alreadyMember: You are already on this menu.
bucketsIntro: Build a menu once, share it with friends or a group, then start a round and collect everyone’s choices in one place.
completeEveryItem: Add a title and complete every item.

confirmLogoutMessage: You will need to sign in again to see your menus and orders.
confirmRemoveMember: Remove this member? Their contributions will be kept in the totals.
contributionFailed: Could not save your change. Retry keeps totals safe.
dashboardIntro: What is open right now and what recently closed, so you can see where a round has got to without opening it.
dashboardIntroNewUser: Let's create your first menu — add a few items, then invite people or place an order.

emptyShared: Nothing is shared with you yet.
emptySharedHint: Ask for a join code, then add it here.

inviteLinkBucketDescription: Anyone who opens this link can join this menu, even if they are not on your friend list.
inviteLinkFriendDescription: Share this link and anyone who opens it can add you to their friend list. It works for as many people as you like and stops working after 24 hours.
inviteLinkFriendHeading: Add this person as a friend
inviteLinkGroupDescription: Anyone who opens this link joins the group directly, with no friend request needed. It stops working after 24 hours.
inviteLinkInvalid: This invite link is not valid or has expired.
joinCodeInvalid: This join code is not valid.
joinCodePlaceholder: Paste the join code you received
localModeNotice: Firebase is not configured. Your data is stored only on this device.
loginIntro: Use your account to access your reusable food lists.
membersIntro: Add the people you order with, group them by team or occasion, and follow requests and activity here.
noContributionsYet: No contributions yet. Set your quantities below.
noMatchingOrders: No matching orders in the loaded results.
notAllowed: You do not have permission for this action.
notFoundBody: The requested page does not exist.
notificationPromptMessage: Get a notification when someone opens an order round, invites you, or your order changes. You can change this any time in Settings.
onlyOwnerCanManage: Only the owner can manage sharing.
ordersEmptyHint: Pick a menu to place your first order.
ordersIntro: Every round you have taken part in, with what you ordered and what your share came to.
otherWaysToInviteHint: A code they type in, if a link will not reach them.
passwordResetDone: Your password was reset. Log in with your new password.
passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters with a letter and a number.
passwordsDoNotMatch: The new password and its confirmation do not match.
quickStart: Build a reusable menu, then place an order in seconds.
registerIntro: Make a menu once and use it again for every order.
requiresRecentLogin: Please log in again, then retry deleting your account.
resetConfirmation: If an account exists for this email, a password-reset message will arrive. Check your spam folder too.
resetIntro: Enter your email and we will send recovery instructions.
resetLinkInvalidBody: The password-reset link is incomplete, has expired, or was already used.
resetLinkInvalidTitle: This reset link is not valid
settingsIntro: Language, currency, theme, privacy, and account. Changes follow you to any device you sign in on.
shareActivityHint: Who joined, ordered, and froze — in order.
sharedBucketEditHint: Structure changes are visible to every member.
sharingDisabledHint: Sharing is off. Enable it to invite people to contribute together.
sharingEnabled: Sharing is enabled. Invite people with a join code.
totalsDriftDetected: Totals drifted from contributions. The owner can repair them.
tourBucketEditorCategoryBody: A category keeps drinks apart from mains. It is optional, but long menus get much easier to scan with it.
tourBucketEditorItemsBody: List every dish once. You can edit or deactivate an item later without touching past orders.
tourBucketEditorNameBody: Use the restaurant's name so the menu is obvious in a list months later. The description is a good place for delivery notes.
tourBucketShareCodeBody: Send this code and anyone can join the menu without an invitation email.
tourBucketShareEnableBody: A menu is private by default. Enable sharing when you are ready for other people to order from it.
tourBucketShareEnableTitle: Sharing is off until you turn it on
tourBucketShareRolesBody: Viewers only look, contributors add their own quantities, editors can change the menu itself.
tourBucketShareRolesTitle: Roles control what people can do
tourBucketsIntroBody: Every menu you own or joined is listed here, newest first, so the one you order from most is easy to find.
tourBucketsRoundBody: Open a new round from a shared menu and everyone on it is invited automatically.
tourBucketsTemplateBody: A menu is a template. Editing it never touches orders you already placed.
tourDashboardSharedBody: When a friend shares a menu, it is counted here so you know how many groups you can order with.
tourDashboardStatsBody: These tiles count your menus, orders, and everything still in progress. Tap one to jump straight there.
tourDashboardWelcomeBody: This is the dashboard. Everything you run — menus, orders, and group rounds — starts from this screen.
tourSessionDetailsMenuBody: These items were copied from the template when the round opened, so later menu edits cannot change it.
tourSessionDetailsParticipantsBody: See at a glance who has ordered, who is still deciding, and who opted out.
tourSessionDetailsStatusBody: The status tells everyone whether choices are still open, locked for ordering, or already settled.
tutorialsReset: Tutorials will show again on each page.
